seo_title: Delhi HC Blocks Fake Sellers Using Titan's TANEIRA Mark
title: Delhi High Court Restrains Unidentified Online Sellers From Commercial Use of Titan's 'TANEIRA' Trademark
case_name: Titan Company Limited v. John Doe and Others (unidentified online sellers)
citation: CS(COMM) 1203/2026; ad-interim order dated 5 November 2026 (Kaurav, J.), next listed 10 December 2026
card_summary: Titan sued unidentified online sellers over unauthorised commercial use of its registered 'TANEIRA' mark. Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav found a prima facie case of ownership and passed an ad-interim injunction restraining commercial use of the mark till the next hearing. The order was passed ex parte on an application under Order XXXIX Rules 1 and 2 CPC.
card_tip: A trademark owner facing unidentified online infringers need not name every seller before seeking relief; courts will restrain unnamed 'John Doe' defendants on a prima facie showing of ownership, pending notice.
verification_notes: The case number CS(COMM) 1203/2026, the bench (Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav), the order date of 5 November 2026, the next listing of 10 December 2026 and the counsel appearance (Pravin Anand for Titan) were read from the order text reproduced in the LiveLawBiz PDF upload, which is the near-primary source. The LiveLawBiz report corroborates the same case number, bench, date and relief. Both sources describe only an ad-interim, ex parte order on the injunction application; no final finding on infringement has been made, so the card states only the interim relief granted and not a final holding.
